name: Living Frontiers — Unpublished Work
notes: Private development checkpoint. The full hero/enemy eight-direction walking and action artwork, bespoke clothing shapes, whole-world graphics review and installed 8.0 Windows acceptance remain unfinished. Twelve five-piece sets and 29 separate equipment templates: 89 new equipment items, with painted icons, 33 new held-object models and distinct offense/defense tradeoffs. Existing owned gear IDs, rolls and upgrades are preserved. Five foods and six physical ingredients bring the total to 100 new item types. Eighteen harvest nodes use bounded active-play regrowth. Thirty-nine campaign quests, fifteen interactive NPCs and unlockable recipes for all 89 new equipment templates. Three adventures with six floors and six bosses; restored mill, outpost and harbor services; graincart, Lantern-Eater and hidden-supplies events. Sixteen original music cues cover all region categories, menu, death and boss encounters. The single music owner stops the old cue before playing the next. Tokboffe has eight standing directions and two full-body stride poses per direction, distance-based gait, diagonal patrol paths at equal speed and a dialogue stop. NPC and ordinary enemy visual turns pass through adjacent 45-degree views; movement and attack clocks retain their existing timing. Diagonal monster walking/action artwork is still unfinished. The development source includes the production Windows client, F10 display settings and F11 fullscreen. Published 7.23.1 remains the installed, verified release; 8.0 is unpublished. Automated checks and native canvas evidence are retained in the development source. They do not replace live gameplay, listening review or installed Windows acceptance for 8.0.
